title: Select a small integer conversion policy
goal: Choose saturation, checked rejection or explicit intermediate and narrowing behaviour when converting floating-point values to small integer storage and validating buffer offsets.

selectionNotes: Choose saturation, checked rejection or explicit intermediate and narrowing behaviour when converting floating-point values to small integer storage and validating buffer offsets.
Only Windows x64 CoreCLR JIT execution is established. RC2 evidence requires actual-GA reconciliation.

platforms: CoreCLR-supported platforms; actual execution measured only on Windows x64 CoreCLR JIT
prerequisites: SDK console project targeting net11.0 with ImplicitUsings=enable and Nullable=enable. Put the supplied complete class in namespace Playbook.Samples.
Choose the numeric policy before changing persisted expectations or buffer access.
constraints: Actual all-five-destination double/float matrix and representative Half values: fractions, both bounds and adjacent overflow, infinities/NaN, checked overflow, ConvertToInteger and native observations; explicit intermediate policies and real bounded buffer write/rejection. Exact compiler/reference/runtime hashes and measured Windows x64 CoreCLR JIT; legacy/native results are observations, not portable historical contracts. No interpreter/Native AOT/Mono or GA execution.
The net10 comparison is not a new foundation or target10 catalogue edition. No provider, rendering mode, native toolchain, workload, account or service is required.
